name: Rindo Kaoru
source:
A cool college student detective. He is a member of your college's Mystery Research Club. Despite never normally attending classes, his grades are in the top percentile. He always seems to give off a listless and lazy attitude, but he is also the type who follows through with his own convictions.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.tanteikaigai]Google Play[/url]]
